flow: 1. Cabinet client nou fără date AI
title: Import client cu AI unknown și intake automat
trigger_real: Consultantul are doar listă de clienți și vrea să pornească misiunea AI Act.
preconditions: Cabinet workspace activ; clientul nu există; niciun AIUseCase.
steps: Import CSV -> Preview -> Commit valid rows -> Deschide Portofoliu -> Intră în execuție client.
expected_objects: Client, ClientWorkspace, ClientMeta, IntakeRequest(draft), 3-4 Findings, AuditEvent
expected_export: Draft AI Discovery Snapshot; export final blocat până la intake/review.
edge_cases: Email invalid; CUI lipsă; client duplicat.
acceptance_criteria: Client creat cu status awaiting_intake; niciun AISystem fake; audit event creat.

flow: 1. Cabinet client nou fără date AI
title: No-file path creează intake, nu sisteme false
trigger_real: Consultantul nu are fișier, dar vrea să trimită link de discovery.
persona: Consultant GDPR care lucrează din email și Word
preconditions: Client creat manual cu companyName/contactEmail; AI status unknown.
steps: Click Nu am fișier -> alege departamente -> generează magic link -> trimite către client.
expected_export: Nu există export final, doar checklist și intake link.
edge_cases: Clientul are doar administrator, fără HR/IT; se creează survey simplificat.
acceptance_criteria: No-file path nu creează AIUseCase; creează status awaiting_client_input.

flow: 1. Cabinet client nou fără date AI
title: Duplicate client după CUI
trigger_real: Cabinet importă același client de două ori din două surse.
persona: Asistent cabinet care face importuri bulk
steps: Import duplicate -> Preview indică duplicate -> alege update_existing -> Commit.
expected_findings: No duplicate workspace; update notes/deadline; no duplicate findings unresolved.
expected_export: Portfolio updated; audit log arată merge/update.
edge_cases: CUI diferit dar nume similar; user trebuie să aleagă manual.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate client workspace created.

flow: 1. Cabinet client nou fără date AI
title: Client declară «nu folosim AI», dar există vendor AI în import
trigger_real: Client spune no AI, dar lista de abonamente conține ChatGPT Team.
steps: Import vendor ChatGPT -> detect mismatch -> creează suspected_ai finding.
expected_export: Draft report include contradicție și caveat.
edge_cases: Vendor este pentru test intern vechi; se poate dismiss cu justificare.
acceptance_criteria: Client status devine suspected_ai, nu no_declared_ai.

flow: 1. Cabinet client nou fără date AI
title: Client parțial: doar management răspunde la intake
trigger_real: Clientul completează doar management form, HR/IT/Marketing nu răspund.
steps: Import responses -> creează use cases doar pentru răspunsuri; restul missing.
expected_export: Management Summary draft cu coverage 25%.
edge_cases: Un departament refuză; status blocked_by_client.
acceptance_criteria: Export final e blocked/draft_only; coverage matrix afișează non-response.

flow: 1. Cabinet client nou fără date AI
title: Client nou cu serviciu AI Literacy în scope
trigger_real: Cabinet vinde pachet AI Act + AI Literacy unui client nou.
steps: Import -> Commit -> verifică De rezolvat și AI Literacy tab.
expected_export: AI Literacy Evidence Pack draft.
edge_cases: Client nu are listă angajați; creează roster checklist.
acceptance_criteria: AI Literacy finding creat automat dacă service_scope conține ai_literacy.

title: Chatbot public fără notice Art.50
trigger_real: Client are chatbot pe site, dar nu informează vizitatorii că interacționează cu AI.
preconditions: Client Magazine Online există; websiteUrl disponibil.
steps: Adaugă use case chatbot -> save -> trigger engine -> atașează screenshot fără notice.
expected_objects: AIUseCase, AISystem, VendorModel draft, TransparencyNotice draft, Findings
expected_export: Transparency section draft; export final blocked până la notice evidence.
edge_cases: Chatbot doar rule-based; consultant poate marca non_ai_candidate.
acceptance_criteria: directInteraction=yes creează Art.50 finding; screenshot fără notice nu rezolvă finding.

title: Chatbot colectează email și număr comandă
trigger_real: E-commerce chatbot colectează date client pentru status comandă.
steps: Import use case + RoPA -> link DataProcess -> generate GDPR findings.
expected_export: AI Register + RoPA/GDPR bridge + evidence appendix.
edge_cases: Vendor nu oferă DPA -> export draft only.
acceptance_criteria: usesPersonalData=yes creează DataProcess și DPA finding.

title: Chatbot cu escaladare umană necunoscută
trigger_real: Support manager nu știe dacă chatbotul escaladează către om.
steps: Set humanReview=unknown -> trigger engine.
expected_export: Open finding în Audit Pack.
edge_cases: Vendor spune 'AI assistant', dar în practică închide tichete automat.
acceptance_criteria: unknown nu este tratat ca no; creează finding de confirmare.

title: Chatbot medical intake pe site clinică
trigger_real: Clinica are formular AI care interpretează simptome și recomandă programări.
preconditions: Client Urban Medica există; website intake activ.
steps: Adaugă use case medical triage -> run risk -> legal review required.
expected_export: Health AI risk memo draft; export final blocked.
edge_cases: Dacă formularul doar colectează simptome fără AI, findings devin obsolete_candidate.
acceptance_criteria: patient_health_data + triage creează critical legal/DPO review.

title: Notice adăugat și verificat
trigger_real: Client remediază lipsa de transparență, adaugă text pe widget.
steps: Atașează notice text + screenshot -> consultant review -> management approval.
expected_findings: art50_chatbot_notice becomes reviewed not automatically closed until approval
expected_export: Transparency export ready.
edge_cases: Screenshot vechi/expirat -> status expired.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence attached -> certainty evidence_attached; requires review before approved.

title: ATS AI ranking candidați
trigger_real: Firmă de recrutare folosește ATS AI care rankează candidați.
persona: Consultant AI Act pentru client HR
steps: Import HR screening row -> commit -> run trigger -> verify findings.
expected_objects: AIUseCase, AISystem, VendorModel draft, DataProcess, Findings
expected_export: HR AI Risk Memo draft; export blocked until legal/DPO review.
edge_cases: Vendor claims only support; scoring/ranking still high-risk candidate.
acceptance_criteria: HR + scoring/ranking=yes creează high_risk_candidate, nu final verdict.

title: ChatGPT manual pentru sumarizare CV
trigger_real: HR încarcă CV-uri în ChatGPT pentru sumarizare înainte de interviu.
preconditions: Client Contabil Plus sau NordHire; use case self-reported.
steps: Magic link response -> create AIUseCase -> vendor review + DPIA findings.
expected_export: Open risk report; no final high-risk until legal review.
edge_cases: HR spune 'doar rezumat', dar îl folosește pentru filtrare -> upgrade risk.
acceptance_criteria: Personal account + CV data creates critical vendor/privacy finding.

title: AI doar pentru descrieri de job
trigger_real: HR folosește AI pentru redactare job descriptions, fără CV-uri/candidați.
persona: Consultant confirmă că nu e screening
preconditions: Client has AIUseCase HR content creation.
steps: Add job description use case -> engine -> confirm no high-risk candidate.
expected_export: Simple HR AI safe-use note.
edge_cases: Dacă HR introduce date candidați, se re-trigrează DPIA/high-risk review.
acceptance_criteria: No high-risk finding if no candidate data/scoring/ranking.

title: Emotion recognition la interviu
trigger_real: Client testează tool de video-interview care detectează emoții.
steps: Create use case with outputType emotion_recognition, department HR -> trigger prohibited_candidate.
expected_export: Export final blocked; legal memo required.
edge_cases: Vendor ascunde funcția ca 'engagement score'. Need legal review.
acceptance_criteria: emotion_recognition + HR/workplace -> prohibited_candidate blocker.

title: Employee productivity monitoring
trigger_real: Companie monitorizează productivitatea angajaților cu AI.
steps: Create use case -> risk triage -> require DPO/legal/worker notice.
expected_export: Employee AI monitoring risk memo.
edge_cases: Se folosește doar agregat anonim? downgrade after review.
acceptance_criteria: Impacts employees -> high-risk candidate review + GDPR DPIA.

flow: 4. IMM nu știe ce AI folosește
title: IMM pornește fără inventar
trigger_real: Operations manager apasă 'Nu știu ce AI folosim'.
steps: Start unknown AI flow -> send survey -> import responses -> create use cases.
expected_export: AI Discovery Snapshot + AI Safe Use Pack draft.
edge_cases: Departments fail to respond -> coverage partial.
acceptance_criteria: No fake AI systems before survey; after responses creates use cases.

flow: 4. IMM nu știe ce AI folosește
title: Survey descoperă ChatGPT personal accounts
trigger_real: Marketing și HR folosesc conturi personale ChatGPT cu date client/candidat.
steps: Import responses -> create use cases -> trigger critical findings.
expected_export: Risk Snapshot with critical shadow AI warning.
edge_cases: Angajații nu știu exact ce date au introdus -> unknown findings.
acceptance_criteria: personal_account + personal/confidential data -> critical.

flow: 4. IMM nu știe ce AI folosește
title: Declară no AI, dar facturi arată Canva AI/Copilot
trigger_real: Management spune 'nu folosim AI', dar billing import include AI tools.
steps: Import billing -> detect AI vendors -> set suspected_ai.
expected_export: Draft report says declared no AI conflicts with billing evidence.
edge_cases: Canva fără AI plan? allow dismiss with evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Mismatch creates finding; no auto accusation.

flow: 4. IMM nu știe ce AI folosește
title: Website chatbot unknown
trigger_real: IMM nu știe dacă widgetul de chat folosește AI.
steps: Start flow -> check website chatbot finding -> attach screenshot/config later.
expected_export: Open Action Plan.
edge_cases: Widget rule-based; finding obsolete after review.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown website chat creates check, not final Art50.

flow: 4. IMM nu știe ce AI folosește
title: AI Safe Use Policy minimă înainte de inventar complet
trigger_real: IMM vrea reguli rapide până termină discovery.
steps: Generate policy -> management approval -> export draft policy pack.
expected_export: AI Safe Use Pack partial.
edge_cases: Policy nu trebuie să pretindă inventar complet.
acceptance_criteria: Export includes partial status and unknowns.

title: Client enterprise cere AI policy, register, training
trigger_real: IMM primește chestionar procurement cu deadline în 7 zile.
steps: Upload questions -> map to evidence -> generate missing findings -> export response pack.
expected_export: Enterprise AI Response Pack with evidence appendix.
edge_cases: Question asks certification not available -> must not fabricate.
acceptance_criteria: Answers without evidence marked self_reported; final requires management approval.

title: HQ cere raport local pentru subsidiară
trigger_real: Multinațională cere operațiunii locale AI register și gap status.
preconditions: Client local exists; HQ questionnaire upload.
steps: Create HQ requirement engagement -> map local use cases -> generate gaps.
expected_export: HQ Local AI Pack.
edge_cases: HQ template cere câmpuri inexistente local; map as not_available/needs_review.
acceptance_criteria: Export must show local coverage and gaps.

title: Chestionar cere ISO 42001/SOC2 inexistente
trigger_real: Enterprise ask: Are you ISO 42001 certified? Provide SOC2.
steps: Map questions -> no evidence -> create guarded answer.
expected_export: Response says not certified, shares AI governance evidence.
edge_cases: User tries to answer 'yes' manually; system flags evidence missing.
acceptance_criteria: No fabricated compliance claim; blocker until reviewed.

title: Deadline azi, minim response pack
trigger_real: Client cere răspuns în aceeași zi.
steps: Create case -> auto classify questions -> generate draft answers + caveats.
expected_export: Draft-only response pack with caveats.
edge_cases: Cannot wait for DPO; mark as draft_only.
acceptance_criteria: Final export blocked; draft export allowed with warnings.

title: Attach previous Audit Pack as evidence
trigger_real: Client already has Audit Pack; enterprise asks for evidence.
steps: Attach Audit Pack -> map to multiple questionnaire items -> review.
expected_export: Enterprise response pack uses prior evidence.
edge_cases: Audit Pack older than 12 months -> expired.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence can satisfy multiple questions but retains date/certainty.

title: Support agent handover cu OpenAI API
trigger_real: AI Builder livrează agent de suport către client enterprise.
preconditions: AI Builder workspace; project not created.
steps: Import YAML -> create AIProject/AISystem/use case -> attach evidence -> generate handover pack.
expected_objects: AIProject, AISystem, AIUseCase, VendorModel, EvidenceItems, Findings, HandoverPack
expected_export: Project Handover Pack v1.
edge_cases: No eval report -> draft only.
acceptance_criteria: intendedPurpose required; final needs product/legal/security review.

title: HR ranker custom pentru client
trigger_real: Builder dezvoltă scoring CV pentru client HR.
steps: Import YAML -> high-risk candidate -> Annex IV/QMS/oversight/logging findings.
expected_export: Handover Pack blocked until legal review.
edge_cases: Client insists system only recommends; remains candidate until legal review.
acceptance_criteria: HR scoring/ranking creates high-risk candidate, not final verdict.

title: Legal contract summarizer for enterprise
trigger_real: Builder livrează sumarizator de contracte intern.
steps: Import YAML -> confidentiality/vendor/DPIA findings -> handover pack.
expected_export: Legal AI Project Handover Pack.
edge_cases: Contracts include personal data; DPIA review.
acceptance_criteria: No high-risk unless impacts people/decisioning.

title: Agent scrie automat în CRM
trigger_real: AI agent actualizează câmpuri CRM și poate declanșa follow-up automat.
steps: Import -> semi-automated action -> require human gate/rollback/logging.
expected_export: Handover Pack includes operational controls.
edge_cases: If agent sends emails autonomously -> increase severity.
acceptance_criteria: Semi-auto actions require oversight and logging findings.

title: No logs available before go-live
trigger_real: Builder nu are logging evidence configurat.
steps: Set logsAvailable=no -> trigger -> export blocked/draft only.
expected_export: Draft Handover Pack only.
edge_cases: Client allows manual logs; set capability sample_logs_uploaded.
acceptance_criteria: Final handover blocked until logs/monitoring evidence attached or accepted.

title: Medical symptom triage assistant
trigger_real: Builder livrează intake simptome pentru clinică.
steps: Import -> health data + triage -> critical legal/DPO reviews.
expected_export: Health AI risk memo; no final until review.
edge_cases: If it only collects form without AI -> downgrade after review.
acceptance_criteria: Patient health data always triggers DPO/legal review.

flow: 7. AI Builder model/config change după go-live
title: Model provider changed after go-live
trigger_real: Builder schimbă providerul modelului din OpenAI în Mistral după go-live.
preconditions: Project Support Agent v1 active; Handover Pack v1 approved.
steps: Create ChangeEvent -> run impact assessment -> require eval/model card/client approval.
expected_export: Change Impact Report v2; Handover Pack v1 unchanged.
edge_cases: Provider equivalent but region/training terms differ.
acceptance_criteria: v1 remains locked; v2 only current after approval.

flow: 7. AI Builder model/config change după go-live
title: Prompt typo minor
trigger_real: Prompt change doar corectează o greșeală de redactare.
steps: Create ChangeEvent -> low severity -> sample eval required.
expected_export: Change log entry; no full pack reissue unless user chooses.
edge_cases: Prompt affects policy/safety instructions? Escalate.
acceptance_criteria: Minor prompt change still creates audit event.

flow: 7. AI Builder model/config change după go-live
title: Logging disabled
trigger_real: Developer dezactivează logging pentru costuri.
steps: Detect config diff -> blocker finding -> export readiness blocked.
expected_export: No approved change until logging restored or exception approved.
edge_cases: Emergency exception requires due date.
acceptance_criteria: High-risk/live system logging disabled -> blocker.

flow: 7. AI Builder model/config change după go-live
title: Data source added CRM personal data
trigger_real: Agent începe să citească date din CRM după go-live.
preconditions: Original project no personal data; new data source CRM.
steps: Create ChangeEvent -> GDPR review -> update data flow/RoPA/DPIA.
expected_export: Change Impact Report with GDPR appendix.
edge_cases: CRM has special category fields -> critical.
acceptance_criteria: data_source_change + personal data triggers DPO review.

flow: 7. AI Builder model/config change după go-live
title: Intended purpose expands to auto-send replies
trigger_real: System changes from drafting replies to sending replies automatically.
preconditions: Support agent active as decision support only.
steps: Create ChangeEvent -> substantial modification review -> client approval.
expected_export: Material Change Report; Handover Pack v2 blocked.
edge_cases: Auto-send only for low-risk FAQ? Still review.
acceptance_criteria: Intended purpose/autonomy change critical; no silent update.

flow: 7. AI Builder model/config change după go-live
title: Human review removed from HR ranker
trigger_real: Client cere să elimine review-ul uman pentru procesare rapidă.
preconditions: HR ranker high-risk candidate active pilot.
steps: Change humanReview to none -> blocker -> legal/DPO/management approval required.
expected_export: No export final; go-live blocked.
edge_cases: Client insists human review exists outside system; needs SOP evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Human review none + HR/ranking = blocker.

flow: 7. AI Builder model/config change după go-live
title: Emergency hotfix
trigger_real: Bug în producție cere hotfix fără review complet.
steps: Mark emergency -> temporary approval -> 48h review finding.
expected_export: Emergency Change Report.
edge_cases: Hotfix changes intended purpose -> cannot temporary approve without legal escalation.
acceptance_criteria: Temporary status expires; review due date required.

title: Client isolation între workspace-uri
trigger_real: Cabinet lucrează pentru Apex, apoi intră în Magazine Online.
steps: Switch execution client -> verify records scoped -> exit -> switch other client.
expected_export: No export contamination.
edge_cases: Browser state stale after switch.
acceptance_criteria: Use cases and evidence from Client A never appear in Client B export.

title: Finding idempotency on repeated import
trigger_real: Același CSV este importat de două ori.
steps: Import same file -> preview shows update/skip -> commit update.
expected_export: Audit log records second import.
edge_cases: User changes owner_email -> update record and keep finding status.
acceptance_criteria: Same triggerCode+useCaseId not duplicated.

title: Export readiness nu permite overclaim
trigger_real: User încearcă să exporte 'fully compliant' fără dovezi.
steps: Click final export -> system checks readiness.
expected_export: Draft export with caveats allowed; final blocked.
edge_cases: User has management approval but no DPO review.
acceptance_criteria: Export final blocked until required reviews complete.
